The Keysight N9048B PXE is a standards-compliant EMI test receiver equipped with pre-selector and LNA designs. N9048B is a highperformance receiver and diagnostic signal analyzer built on an upgradable platform. Perform real-time measurements without missing any transient noises or disturbances. Accelerate time domain scan (TDS) with 350 MHz FFT bandwidth. Simultaneous display of Pk, QP and EMI average results for enhanced test efficiency.
• Availmable frequency range of 1 Hz up to 44 GHz 
• Fully CISPR 16-1-1:2019, MIL-STD-461G, ANSI C63.2 and FCC compliant
• EMC detectors: Peak, Quasi-Peak, EMI Average, RMS Average
• Real time analysis  with EMI detectors, CISPR 16-1-1 compliant
• Real time analysis bandwidth: up to 350 MHz
